commands:
printf %b "Subject: [Fail2Ban] o-a-sendmail-whois-ipmatches: started on <fq-hostname>
Date: `LC_ALL=C date +"%a, %d %h %Y %T %z"`
From: Fail2Ban <fail2ban>
To: root\n
Hi,\n
The jail o-a-sendmail-whois-ipmatches has been started successfully.\n
Regards,\n
Fail2Ban" | /usr/sbin/sendmail -f "fail2ban" "root"

printf %b "Subject: [Fail2Ban] o-a-sendmail-whois-ipmatches: stopped on <fq-hostname>
Date: `LC_ALL=C date +"%a, %d %h %Y %T %z"`
From: Fail2Ban <fail2ban>
To: root\n
Hi,\n
The jail o-a-sendmail-whois-ipmatches has been stopped.\n
Regards,\n
Fail2Ban" | /usr/sbin/sendmail -f "fail2ban" "root"

printf %b "Subject: [Fail2Ban] o-a-sendmail-whois-ipmatches: banned <ip> from <fq-hostname>
Date: `LC_ALL=C date +"%a, %d %h %Y %T %z"`
From: Fail2Ban <fail2ban>
To: root\n
Hi,\n
The IP <ip> has just been banned by Fail2Ban after
<failures> attempts against o-a-sendmail-whois-ipmatches.\n\n
Here is more information about <ip> :\n
`whois <ip> || echo "missing whois program"`\n\n
Matches with <ipfailures> failures IP:<ip>\n
<ipmatches>\n\n
Regards,\n
Fail2Ban" | /usr/sbin/sendmail -f "fail2ban" "root"
stderr: fail2ban.jailreader: WARNING No filter set for jail o-a-sendmail-whois-ipmatches
